title: Note On Office Procedure Forms Of Correspondence

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTER
4848
15-1-33
Note on office procedure - Forms of correspondence
The following are the usual forms in which official correspondence
would be conducted:-

1.  Sir,
    I have the honour to ....................................
    ....................................................
                                I have the honour to be,
                                            Sir,
                                Your most obedient servant,

2.  Sir, (Gentlemen),
    (a) I have to
    (b) I am directed to
                                I am, Sir,
                                Your obedient servant,

3.  Dear Sir,
                                Yours faithfully,

4.  Dear Mr. ............
                                Yours truly,

5.  Dear Mr. or Dear ......... (Surname)
                                Yours sincerely,

Such forms as
Dear Mr. .........
                                Yours faithfully,

Sir,
                                Yours faithfully,

（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER : /m/3 / APR 29 1933 / (CRIME BRANCH)）
page_data.zh:
上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别分部登记簿
4848
1933年1月15日

关于办公程序之附注——公函格式

官方通信通常采用以下格式：-

1.  钧鉴，
    鄙人荣幸地....................................
    ....................................................
                                谨此奉复，
                                            钧鉴，
                                您最恭顺的仆人，

2.  钧鉴，（诸位先生），
    (a) 本人须
    (b) 奉命
                                此致，
                                钧鉴，
                                您恭顺的仆人，

3.  尊敬的先生，
                                您忠实的，

4.  尊敬的............先生
                                您真诚的，

5.  尊敬的先生或尊敬的.........（姓氏）
                                您诚挚的，

诸如
尊敬的.........先生
                                您忠实的，

钧鉴，
                                您忠实的，

等格式

（印章：副警务处长：/m/3 / 1933年4月29日 / （刑事科））

page_data.en:
- 2 -
are not in accordance with the correct forms of official and
demi-official correspondence.
Form No. 1. would be used in addressing officially important
officials, persons, and bodies.
Form No. 2. is a less formal official form and would be
used in answering many official letters which reach us in
form 3.
Form No. 3. is more a business form of letter correspondence
and is not very suitable for official answer.
Form No. 4. may be used where it is desired to give a
personal complexion to a demi-official letter to a person not
personally known, such as a letter to the father of a deceased
officer etc.
Form No. 5. is the correct form to use in demi-official
letters addressed to officials and other persons of standing
known personally to the officer addressing the letter.
Form No. 2 (b) is a suitable form in which to answer a
letter sent out on behalf of the C.P.
The present forms of letter correspondence inter-
departmentally and with the Secretariat are suitable and are
not affected by the preceding notes.
When copies of official documents are attached to a
letter, each copy should bear the endorsement:

True Copy:
(Sd.) F. W. GERRARD.
Commissioner of Police.

Copy to:-
O.C. i/c S.B.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -
不符合官方及半官方通信的正确格式。

格式第1号用于正式致函重要的官员、人士及机构。

格式第2号是一种较不正式的官方格式，用于回复许多以格式第3号发至我处的官方信函。

格式第3号更多属于商业书信往来格式，不太适合作为官方回复。

格式第4号可用于希望给半官方信函增添个人色彩的情形，收信人为非私人相识之人，例如致函已故警官的父亲等。

格式第5号是向发信警官私人相识的官员及其他有地位人士发送半官方信函时应使用的正确格式。

格式第2号(b)是回复代表警务处长（C.P.）发出的信函的合适格式。

目前各部门之间以及与秘书处之间的信函往来格式是合适的，不受前述附注的影响。

当信函附有官方文件副本时，每份副本均应加注如下背书：

经核证无误之副本：
（签名）F. W. GERRARD.
警务处长。

抄送：-
特别分部主管警官
